decision: Not registered. Root PM assigns experiment IDs and registers rules before any real-data fit or scoring.
matrix_row: MX-D4 (uniform TRAIN loss -> recency-weighted TRAIN loss; never run before)
hypothesis: The direct pre-pitch head fitted with recency-weighted TRAIN loss (more weight on rows nearer the 2025-04-30 TRAIN end) predicts the later 2025 DEV outcome distribution differently from the uniform EXP-P15-001 head, alone and in the fixed 1/2 mix with G0-global.
one_change: TRAIN loss weight exp2(-age_days/half_life_days), age = days before 2025-04-30, normalised to mean one. Everything else is EXP-P15-001: inputs with current-pitch physics zero, model, budget, unweighted May 1-15 early stop, May 16-31 Cpanel temperature, June Cpanel frequency blend, Cpanel DEV and frozen whole-MLB DEV.
weight_inputs: game_date only; never outcomes, predictions or DEV
variant_rule: Pre-fixed grid; each variant is one factor vs the same fixed controls. All variants x seeds fit and predict before any comparison; no variant is chosen from seed 0 or from a partial family.
future_confirmation: Seeds 3 and 4 only in a separate registered confirmation after root review.

mix.rule: candidate direct head and the frozen G0-global member of the same seed, member-wise 1/2, then the same June frequency blend; compared with the frozen G15 mix (EXP-P15-002 construction) of the same seeds

unchanged_from_p15.splits: EXP-P4-001 train / earlystop / temperature (May Cpanel) / blend (June Cpanel) / dev (Cpanel) keys; frozen mlb_dev
unchanged_from_p15.calibration: per-seed temperature on the May Cpanel rows (same optimizer and bounds), three-seed probability mean, June frequency blend by the same scorer
unchanged_from_p15.device: auto (mps on the Mac mini, same as the control)

data_rules: No 2026 rows (runner date guard). TRAIN rows only for fitting and weights; May/June Cpanel rows only for early stop, temperature and blend; DEV never used for fitting, weighting, calibration or selection.

metrics.primary_descriptive: Cpanel DEV after the June frequency blend: candidate direct vs frozen uniform direct, and candidate mix vs frozen G15 mix, paired NLL/Brier with whole-game bootstrap, per-seed deltas
secondary_descriptive: Cpanel DEV before the frequency blend
whole-MLB DEV calibrated three-seed mean (no June blend) when --mlb was run
TRAIN weight ESS, ESS ratio and weight share by year (from preparation)

exposure_note: Cpanel and whole-MLB DEV were read repeatedly (P7-003, P11, P13-P16). Results are development comparisons, not confirmation. Three variants form a search; any later selection must be labelled after-search.

order: run  : --output <runs>/<registered id> run --variant <v> --seeds 0 1 2 --mlb   (each of hl180, hl365, hl730)
